units.source_text: 明石女公子的宫中住处，预定为源氏以前的值宿处淑景舍，已加改筑及装饰。

en.t: The Akashi young lady's residence in the palace was to be Shigeisa, Genji's former night-duty quarters, and it had already been remodeled and decorated.

units.source_text: 女公子入宫延期，皇太子等得心焦。

en.t: Because the young lady's entry into the palace was delayed, the Crown Prince and the others grew anxious.
So it was decided that she would enter the palace in the fourth month.

units.source_text: 各种用具，除原有者以外，又添置新品，其雏形及图样，均由源氏太政大臣亲自过目，召集各行各匠，令其精心制作。

en.t: For the various furnishings, new pieces were added to those already on hand; Genji, the Grand Minister, personally inspected the models and designs, summoned craftsmen from every trade, and had them make everything with the greatest care.

units.source_text: 藏在书箱里的图册，均选用可作习字帖者。

en.t: The illustrated albums kept in the book boxes were all chosen from works suitable to serve as calligraphy copybooks.

units.source_text: 其中不乏古代一流书法家所作盖世闻名的作品。

en.t: Among them were many world-renowned works by first-rate calligraphers of antiquity.

units.source_text: 源氏对紫夫人说：“世风日下，万事不及古代，愈来愈见浅薄。

en.t: Genji said to Lady Murasaki, "The ways of the world decline day by day; in everything we fall short of ancient times and seem ever more shallow.

units.source_text: 只有假名的书法，今世进步无量。

en.t: Only the calligraphy of kana has made immeasurable progress in this age.

units.source_text: 古人所写的假名，虽然合乎一定的法则，但是缺乏流畅生动之相，似乎千篇一律。

en.t: The kana written by people of old follows certain rules, but it lacks a flowing, lively quality and seems almost uniformly the same.

units.source_text: 到了近代，才有假名书法的妙手相继出世。

en.t: Only in more recent times have masters of kana calligraphy appeared one after another.

units.source_text: 我曾有一时热衷于此道，搜集许多优良范本。

en.t: For a time I too was absorbed in this art and collected many excellent models.

units.source_text: 其中皇后的母亲六条妃子所写的，漫不经心，信笔疾书，草草一行，纯熟自然。

en.t: Among them, the writing of Rokujo, the Empress's mother, looked casual, dashed off freely by the brush in a single hasty line, yet it was accomplished and natural.

units.source_text: 我访得之后，认为绝世佳作。

en.t: After I managed to obtain it, I regarded it as an unparalleled masterpiece.

units.source_text: 为此与她结了不解之缘，留下了薄幸之名。

en.t: Because of that, I formed an inextricable bond with her and left behind a reputation for being ill-fated in love.

units.source_text: 当时她曾痛悔，然而我非无情之人，也曾尽心竭力地照顾她的女儿。

en.t: At the time she bitterly regretted it, but I was not a heartless man, and I did all I could to care for her daughter.

units.source_text: 她是贤明之人，虽在九泉之下，定能谅解我心。

en.t: She was a wise woman, and even beneath the nine springs she surely understands my heart.
" By the end of these words, his voice had grown very soft.
